title: document.write/v1 approved payload
description: document.write/v1 is an effect submitted through change.propose/v1, not a directly callable tool. target.locator is the exact library-relative file/folder path, never a workspace path, URL, bucket or object key. Every operation requires exactly one changes item: path=/document, action=SET, value as follows. CREATE/UPDATE: value={artifact_ref,content_hash,size_bytes,mime_type}; copy the original Run Artifact reference, SHA-256 hash and byte size from its tool receipt (artifact.append uses content_hash and bytes_written; document.convert uses artifact.content_hash and artifact.size_bytes, never the source document.checksum or document.size). mime_type is text/markdown, text/plain or application/json. Do not use /artifact_ref, /artifact, /content, raw text, or omit hash/size. MOVE/MOVE_FOLDER (including rename): value={destination}, the complete new relative path. RESTORE: value={document_id}, the original recycled document UUID. CREATE_FOLDER/TRASH/DELETE_FOLDER: value={}. precondition.revision is absent for CREATE/CREATE_FOLDER; otherwise copy document.files stat state.revision, not the content hash, ETag or listing revision. verification is READ_BACK with paths=[/document] and may be omitted for platform derivation. When document.files/v1 is available, prefer action=prepare with library_key=resource_key, operation, path, purpose and the operation-specific fields; CREATE/UPDATE need artifact_ref and mime_type, other than CREATE/CREATE_FOLDER supply the observed expected_revision. It resolves Artifact metadata and returns the exact proposal: submit it with its evidence_refs without rewriting content. Preparation is not a write. Only use operations authorized in the Run; approval, conflict checks and read-back remain mandatory.
